Legionella Risk Assessments in Glasgow

For Glasgow rental properties, a Legionella risk assessment helps landlords and agents document sensible water-system checks and identify practical control measures. Scotland EPC keeps the process clear, direct and easy to arrange.

Who this is for

Landlords, letting agents and property managers looking after domestic rental properties in Glasgow, Bearsden, Bishopbriggs and nearby Central Belt areas.

Assessment focus

  • Domestic hot and cold water arrangements.
  • Potential stagnation points and outlet usage patterns.
  • Clear notes for landlord records and follow-up actions.

Bundle option

A standalone Legionella assessment starts from £55. If you also need an EPC, the combined bundle starts from £100.
